title: Non-abelian quantum cellular automata: $1{+}1$-dimensional $SU(2)$ Yang--Mills with fermions
summary: This work provides a digital quantum simulation scheme for $1{+}1$-dimensional $SU(2)$ Yang--Mills theory with Dirac fermions. It takes the form of a quantum circuit, infinitely repeating across space and time with $Δ_t=Δ_x=\varepsilon$, whose wires follow lightlike propagation. The construction mirrors the logic of the standard quantum field theory approach, transposed to the discrete setting.
